risk: Timing flags and reusable approval labels allowed stale scene evidence to advance.
proof: HEAD checked configuration and booleans without a source-bound Manim receipt. A regression removed proofPath while keeping the flag true.
fix: Require actual Whisper words, a hashed Manim timing receipt and an approval hash bound to scene, version, policy and Premiere intent.
verification: Timing-flag, independent Whisper phrase and evidence revision tests.

risk: An episode ledger could pass while the chosen scene was rejected or absent from its lane.
proof: Pending discovery covered seven lanes but did not match sceneId to a candidate. The rejected-candidate test reproduced it.
fix: Bind sceneId and anchor to one candidate in the selected lane.

risk: Scene planners overwrote active enrollment and printed fabricated approvals; the rank planner also edited a canonical source.
proof: HEAD hardcoded the Week 2 input, wrote active-scene.json and declared Jerami approval without review.
fix: Require explicit episode configuration; print pending plans; preserve Components and reject duplicate scene creation.
verification: Planner test compares active enrollment bytes and rejects destructive replay code.

risk: Failed or malformed MCP envelopes could report matching data as success.
proof: Regression responses embedded success:false/status:failed/error in text content alongside valid clip data. Numeric and string success flags also advanced.
fix: Parse structured envelopes and reject failed or malformed success indicators before readback validation.

risk: Declared motion tracks could substitute for measured Figma motion.
proof: A matching Figma root without motion tracks previously passed. Sibling evidence could supply unrelated properties.
fix: Require measured tracks on the exact matching scene, including cue, node, property, duration and keyframes.
verification: Missing, changed and sibling motion-track tests. Native Figma execution remains a separate live check.

risk: A timed-out import or placement could be replayed, creating duplicate media or clips.
proof: HEAD retained no durable reservation between the preflight and uncertain external response.
fix: Atomically reserve scene/stage attempts; reconcile existing IDs before any deliberate retry.
verification: Repeat import and placement are denied; partial-success responses request ID readback.

risk: Episode export approval could bypass scene enrollment and permit unrelated polling jobs.
proof: HEAD roster branch accepted any listed scene and arbitrary job IDs, bypassing normal receipt checks.
fix: Require exact scene approval and receipt; bind job IDs to scene and full manifest revision; allow the first export before render proof exists.
verification: Export job rebind, mismatch and roster enforcement checks.

risk: Player compositing accepted alpha declarations without pixels or preserved-original proof.
proof: An alphaRequired flag was asset-fit evidence only. The no-alpha test advanced before pixel validation.
fix: Check files, hashes, alpha pixels and exact ledger slot; retain human identity and edge review.
verification: Missing proof, opaque pixels and stale-original tests; Cinematic remains full-photo.

risk: A hashed text file and invented frame hashes could satisfy delivery proof.
proof: The hashed-non-video regression was allowed before media validation. Portable HEAD MP4 fixture contains synthetic text bytes.
fix: Probe real video dimensions/rate/duration and compare actual image files with decoded video frames before import and reconciliation.
verification: Actual synthetic 1080p media exercises delivery on verified HomeSSD; hashed non-video and missing cue images fail.

risk: Lineups destructiveness checks affected unrelated Premiere targets.
proof: HEAD globally scoped destructive operations; unrelated-item and sequence tests reproduced the block.
fix: Scope by enrolled file, export path, sequence/item/clip IDs and supported batch ID lists.
verification: Unrelated Figma/Premiere tests and existing 745/routing checks.

risk: Recursive sequence matching could mix clips from different sequences or accept duplicate IDs.
proof: Pending parser accepted the first matching clip and inherited sequence identity while recursing.
fix: Require one exact clip in its direct sequence/track container; keep source In/Out separate from padded duration.
verification: Duplicate identity, nested sequence and trimmed source-range tests.

risk: Two source IDs could reuse one image in Cinematic 2-up.
proof: Pending Cinematic checks compared node/source IDs without distinct image hashes.
fix: Reject repeated photo hashes while preserving full photos, original backgrounds, opening visibility and title placement.
verification: Cinematic duplicate hash and layout tests.

risk: Cue proof extraction could write generated media to internal storage.
proof: HEAD accepted any --output directory. The updated command rejected /tmp before extraction and created no files.
fix: Verify HomeSSD and enforce the physical Catena previews path, including symlink resolution.
verification: Internal-output rejection and existing physical-storage gate tests.

risk: The enrolled Jaguars episode carries stale timing evidence and cannot progress safely.
proof: Current check:lineups:framing fails: stored manifest SHA adaf1075a233edd5a026fdbe6a0692a6db3810684215d2123ab5f51f16bbd5f1 differs from current b22cdff94cfb7a82dff35e8fbeae7cdaf93680d2f5a96ba3d64f117d98a96fa5. HEAD has no enrolled episode.
fix: Regenerate source-bound episode evidence from actual sources, read back the current scene and obtain scene-specific human approval before production. Keep this client state outside the reusable code commit.
verification: Mixed-checkout npm run verify stopped at the stale framing assertion; no client app or media was changed.
